integrity: Proof uses exact integral relative incidence blocks and explicit acyclic discrete-Morse matchings independently replayable with the included standard-library program. Existing perfect-matching classification is properly credited; the inclusion map is a separate result.
scientific_limitations: One specific ten-vertex Möbius ladder; no general statement about larger ladders, symmetry actions, or persistence in other graph families.
title: An index-four inclusion between Möbius-ladder matching complexes
